{"consolidated_memory":"CONSOLIDATED MEMORY: Multiple loss divergence issues in ml/train/loop.py (2026-03-03 to 2026-07-04)

This is a record of FIVE SEPARATE OCCASIONS where loss divergence was detected in the training loop in the same corner of ml/train/loop.py (ml pipeline side). Each occurrence had a distinct trigger condition, root cause, and fix.

OCCASION 1: 2026-03-03
- Trigger: accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- Signal: loss curve turns upward and never returns
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of digest
- PR #2390, branch: fix/loss-divergence-2
- Repro: train two epochs on small split
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 18%, to 445 requests per second

OCCASION 2: 2026-03-06
- Trigger: input list came in empty
- Signal: loss curve turns upward and never returns
- Root cause: error swallowed by bare except clause
- Fix: narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #3890, branch: fix/loss-divergence-3
- Repro: train two epochs on small split
- Measured outcome: reclaimed 7 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 3: 2026-06-02
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Signal: loss curve turns upward and never returns
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #5037, branch: fix/loss-divergence-4
- Repro: train two epochs on small split
- Measured outcome: flaky test went from 27 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 4: 2026-06-04
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Signal: loss curve turns upward and never returns
- Root cause: race condition in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #5663, branch: fix/loss-divergence-5
- Repro: train two epochs on small split
- Measured outcome: cold start dropped 53%, to 376 ms

OCCASION 5: 2026-07-04
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Signal: loss curve turns upward and never returns
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #6524, branch: fix/loss-divergence-6
- Repro: train two epochs on small split
- Measured outcome: memory settled at 150 MB instead of climbing past 4 GB"}
